notablePrerequisites:
Vampiric Link and Sunbond attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Remove a +1+1 counter from Deathbringer Thoctar to have it deal 1 damage to an opponent.
Vampiric Link triggers, gaining you 1 life.
Deathbringer Thoctar gets a +1+1 counter from Sunbond.
Repeat until opponent are dead.
